statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, T≤X → H≤X → (X:ℝ)^((7:ℝ)/120+ε) ≤ (H:ℝ) → (((Finset.Icc (X-H) X).filter (fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n))).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(H:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在 7/120+ε 的短区间门槛，把对数节省加强到区间长度的固定幂节省。
plain_statement.en: Replace the logarithmic saving by a power of the interval length at the original threshold.

brief.zh: 固定 ε 后 δ 对所有起点一致。用高矩或大值估计控制坏频率，仅改良对数常数无济于事。
brief.en: Bound the large-frequency tail by a fixed power, uniformly in each interval endpoint.
